result.reason: The redline appropriately extends use rights to Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer’s behalf and limits revocation to an uncured material breach. However, it omits transferability to successors, which is required under both the preferred and fallback positions. It also does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable; instead, the breach-based revocation standard applies without distinguishing paid-up from subscription licences. The margin comment does not cure these operative omissions. The changes made are targeted and otherwise preserve the use limitation and software restrictions.
